purpose: Establish the current-f01e AutoRound TP1/MTP4/eager/F16 exact-8K parent with isolated draft/acceptance counters, conservative exact target-only token verification, the full frozen quality battery, and strict cleanup. This fills only the parent sentinel and authorizes no automatic descendants.

prior_evidence.e9d_eager_mtp: TP1 eager MTP1/2/3 booted and accepted well but collapsed to roughly 4.5/4.4/4.3 tok/s; MTP4 was not measured in that matrix.
prior_evidence.b2dd_mtp2: Full MTP2 drafted 10040 and accepted 7391 (73.6155%) and passed quality, but matched a separate-boot target oracle only 23/25; it was conservatively quarantined without causal corruption attribution and its dependent MTP4 was not run.
prior_evidence.historical_mtp4: Earlier MTP4 execution proves the recurrent shape can run, but margin/shared-baseline evidence is not valid current-f01e parent proof.
prior_evidence.external_artifact: NONE. Do not bind the unrelated llama.cpp external Q4_0 MTP artifact; it diverged from its target at token 6.

reopen_basis: The f01e runtime is materially newer than e9d and b2dd, and current TP1/MTP4 remains unproven. This separately preregistered exact-8K parent uses the native embedded MTP package and conservative fail-closed gates.

target_oracle.gate: candidate token IDs must exactly equal all 128 frozen target-only token IDs; mismatch quarantines but does not alone prove MTP corruption because the oracle is cross-boot

quality_contract.full_pass: seven exact cases, eight-repeat one-hash determinism, 8K needle, 24 baseline comparisons, and cache zero
quality_contract.gate: Full battery must pass after exact 8K: pass_all, baseline_match_all, seven exact cases, eight repeats with one hash, 8K needle, 24 baseline booleans, and cache zero.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-sentinel: Exact depth, positive drafting/acceptance, exact frozen target token equality, full quality, identity, and cleanup all pass.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: Exact 8K passes but isolated drafting/acceptance counters do not prove active accepted speculation.
terminal_classification.quarantined-target-verification-failed: Exact 8K passes but candidate token IDs differ from the frozen same-image target-only receipt; no causal MTP-corruption claim from this cross-boot mismatch alone.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: Exact 8K and mechanism gates pass but the full quality battery fails.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an exact-image log line explicitly classifying the native MTP/speculative method as unsupported.
terminal_classification.failed: Generic timeout/startup failure, exact binding failure, identity mismatch, request/metrics failure, cleanup failure, or other non-explicit failure.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model
speculator_binding.recurrent_contract: one native MTP module is recurrently reused for four speculative steps

acceptance_contract.snapshot_scope: Prometheus counters immediately before and immediately after the exact 8K request; startup and quality traffic excluded
acceptance_contract.gate: drafted delta > 0 and accepted delta > 0 and accepted <= drafted
